```python
import pandas as pd
file_path = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/7cc4acfa-63fd-4acc-a1a1-e8e529e0a97f.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path)
sales_cols = ['Burgers','Hot Dogs','Salads','Fries','Ice Cream','Soda']
# Normalize location for matching
df['loc_norm'] = df['Location'].str.lower()
# Fast filter for target cities (lowercased)
cities = ['wharvton ', 'algrimand']  # quick list
filtered = df[df['loc_norm'].isin(cities)]
city_totals = filtered.groupby('loc_norm')[sales_cols].sum().sum(axis=1)
# Ensure both cities present in output
city_totals = city_totals.reindex(['wharvton','algrimand'], fill_value=0)
print(city_totals)
```
